summary.name: Artflow
summary.one_liner: Artflow is an AI image and video tool that builds a personal "Actor" from a set of your photos so you can generate portraits, videos and print-ready designs featuring your own face.
use_cases: Making LinkedIn headshots and website portraits without a photographer
Creating a week of social media reels and posts featuring your face
Designing posters, product mockups and video ads with your branding
Generating fantasy, editorial or holiday card images starring yourself
Producing personalized video walkthroughs or greetings
summary.what_it_does: Artflow lets you train an AI "Actor" from 10–20 clear photos of your face, which takes about 10–30 minutes according to the FAQ. You can then generate images and videos of that identity in different settings, outfits and lighting, and across formats such as reels, stories and posts. Editing tools include background removal, inpainting and upscaling to 64 megapixels. The page also lists hundreds of templates, props and sets, and a poster and mockup designer for print-ready artwork. Dual Actors (two identities in one scene) are listed as coming soon.
notable: Personal AI Actor trained from 10-20 of your own photos
Upscaling up to 64 megapixels for print-ready output
Monthly credit allocation; first Actor included with every plan
Hundreds of scene templates with one-tap use
caveats: Paid plans are needed for premium templates, video model access, watermark-free images and bulk download; the free tier is limited, and a 'try free' option exists with no credit card required
Images and videos consume monthly credits, and retraining an Actor uses credits
Multi-Actor (dual identity) scenes are listed as coming soon
Only train Actors using photos you have rights to, per the Terms of Service
